cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(cache_package_consumer LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
option(NAUTILUS_CACHE_EXPECTED "Require the installed cache target" OFF)
find_package(MLIR CONFIG QUIET)
find_package(nautilus CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(cache-package-consumer main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cache-package-consumer PRIVATE nautilus::nautilus)
if (NAUTILUS_CACHE_EXPECTED)
    if (NOT TARGET nautilus::nautilus-cache)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The installed package lacks nautilus::nautilus-cache")
    endif ()
    target_link_libraries(cache-package-consumer PRIVATE nautilus::nautilus-cache)
    target_compile_definitions(cache-package-consumer PRIVATE NAUTILUS_CACHE_EXPECTED)
elseif (TARGET nautilus::nautilus-cache)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "A cache-OFF package unexpectedly exports the cache target")
endif ()
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    target_compile_options(cache-package-consumer PRIVATE -fPIE)
    target_link_options(cache-package-consumer PRIVATE -pie "LINKER:--build-id=sha1")
endif ()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME cache-package-ordinary COMMAND cache-package-consumer ordinary)
if (NAUTILUS_CACHE_EXPECTED AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux"
        AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|AMD64)$")
    add_test(NAME cache-package-cold COMMAND cache-package-consumer cold "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cache")
    add_test(NAME cache-package-warm COMMAND cache-package-consumer warm "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cache")
    set_tests_properties(cache-package-cold PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP cache-package-entry)
    set_tests_properties(cache-package-warm PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED cache-package-entry)
endif ()
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    get_property(consumer_tests DIRECTORY PROPERTY TESTS)
    set_tests_properties(${consumer_tests} PROPERTIES
            ENVIRONMENT "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:nautilus::nautilus>:$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}")
endif ()
